messages:
Nadia: Heads-up: customers and sales pushing SSO + embeddings. We need a compact way to lock MVP so we don't keep slipping dates. Proposal: a 'milestone ladder' + clear rules for customer asks.
Marco: +1. can we make a short decision rule list so PMs can triage asks without weekly fires?
Nadia: thinking: 3 milestones and simple gating rules. Quick draft below.
Priya: post the draft pls. want to see impact on design resourcing.
Nadia: Milestone 1 (MVP launch): core gen endpoints, basic auth, prompt templates, default single-tenant routing. Milestone 2 (Rapid post-launch, weeks 0-6): opt-in embeddings pilot, lightweight telemetry page, cache improvements. Milestone 3 (v1, weeks 6-12): SSO, multi-tenant routing, Dedicated/reserved infra and audit features. Gating rules: 1) Any security/legal blocker -> v1 gating review; 2) Performance: P50 <250ms and no >5% error spikes on top 10 demos; 3) Customer revenue blocking (closed deal requiring feature) -> consider moving to v1 but require sales+legal sign-off.
Marco: engineering note: SSO + multi-tenant are coupled ~4wk work. Moving them to v1 buys runway for launch polish. embeddings as opt-in behind flag is doable.
Tom: design: can ship basic telemetry and flag UX for pilots; full analytics as v1. Need 2 microcopy reviews.
Priya: ops: Dedicated infra requires capacity planning and billing commitments. we should not promise Dedicated at launch without finance approval. opened ticket FIN-783.
Marco: propose prioritization policy: if ask is security/legal/sales-blocking -> escalate to v1 gating review within 48h. otherwise default to Post-launch. keeps MVP focused.
Nadia: decision ask: agree to ladder + move SSO and multi-tenant to v1, embeddings to Post-launch opt-in. react :thumbsup: to approve or list blockers now.
Tom: :thumbsup: (will add microcopy PR).
Marco: :thumbsup: adding dev checklist for feature flags.
Priya: :thumbsup: pending FIN-783 approval.
